Existing boundary: The learner can explain that x - 1 turns the lowest 1 bit into 0 and the zeros below it into 1s, so x & (x - 1) clears exactly that bit; repeating it until 0 counts the 1 bits (10110 takes 3), and x > 0 is a power of two exactly when one repeat gives 0.
